name: oni-game
description: リアル鬼ごっこ（鬼ごっこ＋ミッション＋情報戦）。iOS（SwiftUI）アプリ・Firebase サーバー・Web 版

scripts.test:emulator: npm run functions:build && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,database,functions,tasks --project demo-oni-game "node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests-emulator/*.test.js"
scripts.emulators: npm run functions:build && firebase emulators:start --only auth,database,functions,tasks --project demo-oni-game
scripts.supabase:start: npm run supabase:build && npx supabase start
scripts.supabase:functions: npm run supabase:build && npx supabase functions serve
scripts.supabase:test: npm run supabase:build && npx supabase db reset --local && npx deno test --allow-net --allow-env --allow-read --config supabase/functions/deno.json supabase/functions/_shared/tests/
